requirement.value: Sharpshooter, Batman (Squire) or Prizefighter (Weaponmaster) mastery + Arming Maneuver

system.description: When Arming Maneuver both makes a free attack with a weapon you just equipped and swaps equipment with an ally, that ally may attack alongside you. Both attacks treat High Roll as 0 and both deal extra damage equal to your Skill Level in Arming Maneuver. You generate an opportunity if any two of the four dice rolled show 6 or higher and match.
